Story: docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md
Implementation: - Core plugin entry point src/index.ts: - Annotated with this story and its key requirements: - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md - @req REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE - Provide foundational plugin export and registration - @req REQ-ERROR-HANDLING - Gracefully handles plugin loading errors and missing dependencies - Implements a rule registry and dynamic rule loading: - const RULE_NAMES = [ "require-story-annotation", "require-req-annotation", "require-branch-annotation", "valid-annotation-format", "valid-story-reference", "valid-req-reference", "prefer-implements-annotation", ] as const; - const rules: Record = {} as any; - RULE_NAMES.forEach(name => { try { const mod = require(`./rules/${name}`); rules[name] = mod.default ?? mod; } catch (error) { /* error handling, see below */ } }); - Defines flat-config style configurations for ESLint v9: - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES maps each traceability/* rule to "error" or "warn". - createTraceabilityFlatConfig() returns { plugins: { traceability: {} }, rules: { ...TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES } }. - const configs = { recommended: [createTraceabilityFlatConfig()], strict: [createTraceabilityFlatConfig()] }. - Exports in standard ESLint plugin shape and as default export: - export { rules, configs, maintenance }; - export default { rules, configs, maintenance }; - Rule modules present for all referenced rules (REQ-RULE-REGISTRY): - src/rules/contains: require-story-annotation.ts, require-req-annotation.ts, require-branch-annotation.ts, valid-annotation-format.ts, valid-story-reference.ts, valid-req-reference.ts, prefer-implements-annotation.ts.
Error handling (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): - src/index.ts wraps dynamic rule loading in try/catch: - On failure, logs a descriptive error: - console.error(`[eslint-plugin-traceability] Failed to load rule "${name}": ${error.message}`); - Installs a placeholder RuleModule that: - meta.docs.description: `Failed to load rule '${name}'`. - create(context) reports on Program: `eslint-plugin-traceability: Error loading rule "${name}": ${error.message}`. - Tested in tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts: - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md, @req REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. - Mocks ../src/rules/require-branch-annotation to throw Error("Test load error"). - Requires ../src/index and asserts: - console.error called with message containing: Failed to load rule "require-branch-annotation": Test load error. - plugin.rules["require-branch-annotation"] defined. - placeholderRule.meta.docs.description contains the failure text. - placeholderRule.create(fakeContext).Program(...) calls report with message containing the error text. - CLI-level error behavior tested in tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts: - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md, @req REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. - Spawns ESLint CLI with this plugin and config; asserts non-zero exit and presence of the expected error message when annotations are missing, confirming end-to-end behavior when rules fail or are misconfigured.
Core plugin structure and exports (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM): - tests/plugin-setup.test.ts: - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md, @req REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE. - import plugin, { rules, configs } from "../src/index"; - Asserts: - rules and configs are defined and are objects. - plugin.rules === rules and plugin.configs === configs. - tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts: - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md (and 007.0 for error severity). - Validates default export composition: - plugin.rules and plugin.configs match named exports. - Validates rules registry: - Object.keys(rules) equals the expected list of rule names in order. - Validates recommended config (REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM): - configs.recommended[0].rules has traceability/require-story-annotation, traceability/require-req-annotation, traceability/require-branch-annotation set to "error". - Validates strict config mirrors recommended (REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM): - configs.strict[0].rules equals configs.recommended[0].rules. - Validates severity mapping (cross-story, but confirms structure is consistent).
ESLint v9 flat-config integration (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT): - Plugin config shape (configs.recommended/strict returning arrays of flat config objects with plugins and rules) matches ESLint v9 flat config expectations. - Project-level eslint.config.js uses a flat config and wires in the plugin: - Requires the plugin from ./src/index.js or ./lib/src/index.js, with CI guard on missing build. - For TypeScript and JS files, sets: - plugins: { ...(plugin.rules ? { traceability: plugin } : {}) }. - This demonstrates correct usage of the plugin in an ESLint v9 flat config environment. - tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts: - @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md, @req REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE. - Resolves ESLint CLI (eslint/bin/eslint.js), uses the project’s eslint.config.js via --config. - runEslint(code, rule) spawns ESLint with: - --no-config-lookup, --config , --stdin, and a traceability/* rule. - it.each over multiple TestCase scenarios asserts exit status matches expectations (0 or 1) based on annotations present or missing. - Confirms that when used via ESLint CLI with flat config, the plugin registers correctly and its rules execute.
NPM package + TypeScript setup (REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP): - package.json: - name: "eslint-plugin-traceability" (standard ESLint plugin naming). - main: "lib/src/index.js" and types: "lib/src/index.d.ts" → publishable Node module with type declarations. - peerDependencies: { "eslint": "^9.0.0" } → explicitly targets ESLint v9. - engines: { "node": ">=18.18.0" }. - scripts include build (tsc), test (jest), type-check, lint, and CI verification flows. - tsconfig.json: - compilerOptions: { module: "CommonJS", outDir: "lib", strict: true, declaration: true, ... }. - include: ["src", "tests"]. - Confirms the plugin is written in TypeScript and compiled to a Node/Eslint-compatible structure. - Jest test infrastructure (REQ-TEST-SETUP): - jest.config.js uses ts-jest preset, collects coverage from src, ignores lib, and matches tests in tests/**/*.test.ts. - Provides a full test environment for rule and plugin validation.
User experience and documentation (User Experience, Documentation): - README.md: - Attribution and overview. - Installation: - npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-traceability - yarn add --dev eslint-plugin-traceability - ESLint v9 flat config example: ```js import js from "@eslint/js"; import traceability from "eslint-plugin-traceability"; export default [js.configs.recommended, traceability.configs.recommended]; ``` - Quick Start flat config example with traceability.configs.recommended only, plus an annotated sample function and an ESLint CLI invocation. - Lists all available plugin rules with links to per-rule docs under docs/rules/. - Documents how to run tests and quality checks (npm test, npm run lint, npm run format:check, npm run duplication). - docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md: - "Plugin Structure Overview" explaining plugin shape (meta, configs, rules, processors). - Basic plugin template in TypeScript. - Testing strategy (RuleTester, Jest) and project-specific build/TS configuration. - These satisfy the story’s requirement for documented plugin structure and development setup.
Tests execution evidence: - npm test script is configured as: - "test": "jest --ci --bail" in package.json. - Command executed via tool: - npm test -- --runInBand --verbose - Output: > eslint-plugin-traceability@1.0.5 test > jest --ci --bail --runInBand --verbose - No errors or failures are reported in the captured output, consistent with a correctly wired Jest configuration. The presence and content of multiple focused tests specifically referencing this story (plugin-setup, plugin-default-export-and-configs, plugin-setup-error, cli-error-handling, cli-integration) provide direct behavioral coverage of the story’s requirements.
Traceability: - src/index.ts and all relevant test files include @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md with @req tags mapping to REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE and REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. - This ensures strong, explicit linkage from the story to implementation and tests.
